result.freshness_policy: live: every search reads the catalog through ongoing's API; the catalog itself is rescanned daily at 04:00 and reports degraded once its last complete scan is more than 72h behind, which is ongoing's own freshness rule

debug_stall_ms.description: Artificial pre-fetch delay, for recording the cancellation conformance case. Leave unset in real configuration.

max_candidates.description: Cap on candidates returned by one search.

replay.description: Directory of recorded API responses named <endpoint>.<status>.json, relative to the declaring configuration file. When set, no request leaves the process, which is what lets a conformance transcript and an evaluation pack exercise this adapter without a live instance.

timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout. Composes with the request deadline; the sooner wins.

views.description: Restrict this source to projects in any of ongoing's attention classifications. Empty means every visible project.
